title: Qwen-UI-Agent Technical Report: Toward Next-Generation Real-World Centric Foundation GUI Agents
task: Multi-platform GUI agent for real-world device automation
key_results: 82.1% MobileWorld, 92.2% MobileWorld-Real, 97.5% AndroidDaily; 79.5% OSWorld-Verified
comments: Comprehensive system combining mobile and desktop automation with online RL at scale (10,000+ concurrent environments); state-of-the-art on mobile benchmarks.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Unified action space combining GUI and CLI execution improves cross-platform task completion
hypotheses.result: Competitive with frontier models on web/desktop while leading on mobile

title: Metis: Memory Foundation Model
task: Native memory capabilities for foundation models
key_results: Memory attention enables gradient-free online maintenance; pairing 6.9B memory with Pythia-410M surpasses Pythia-12B with 39% fewer parameters
comments: First memory foundation model treating memory as learned procedure rather than external module; parameter-efficient alternative to pure model scaling.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Native memory with persistent, evolving state outperforms external memory modules
hypotheses.result: Better parameter-performance tradeoff and end-to-end optimization demonstrated across benchmarks

title: PhiZero: A World Model Built Around Physical Language
task: Physical world modeling via discrete physical language
key_results: PhiZero enables zero-shot motion transfer and fine-grained action-conditioned simulation with physically coherent video generation
comments: Novel reason-then-render paradigm using discrete language for explicit world dynamics; bridges gap between implicit pixel-space prediction and explicit reasoning.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Discrete physical language representation enables better transfer of learned dynamics to new scenes
hypotheses.result: Zero-shot motion transfer and improved action-conditioned simulation demonstrated

title: Frontis-MA1: Training an AI4AI Model towards Recursive Self-Improvement in Machine Learning Engineering
task: Meta-evolution agent for recursive self-improvement in ML engineering
key_results: Frontis-MA1 improves MLE-Bench Lite from 39.39% to 71.21%; transfers to held-out NatureBench (50% to 70% Match-SOTA)
comments: Post-trained 35B model with program-evolution operators; demonstrates recursive capability improvement through execution-grounded training.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Evolution operators (Draft, Improve, Debug, Crossover) as atomic units enable better long-horizon ML search
hypotheses.result: Significant improvement over base model and transfer to held-out benchmarks

title: AskChem: Claim-Centered Infrastructure for Chemistry Literature Synthesis
task: Claim-centered cross-paper chemistry search infrastructure
key_results: 100% resolvable DOIs with AskChem vs 88.3% without; 2.4M claims indexed from 147K papers
comments: Shifts retrieval unit from papers to provenance-grounded claims; high citation density with web, SDK, and MCP agent interfaces.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Claim-level grounding improves answer resolution and verifiability versus document-level retrieval
hypotheses.result: 100% resolvable citations and highest citation density among tested systems

title: VideoCoCo: Code-as-CoT for Physically-Consistent Video Generation via an Agentic Dual-Engine System
task: Physically consistent video generation via executable code chains-of-thought
key_results: PhyGenBench: 0.475→0.558; VBench-2.0: 52.18→77.88; state-of-the-art on both benchmarks
comments: Dual-engine framework using Blender code as explicit process reasoning; decouples spatiotemporal structure from photorealism.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Executable code intermediate representation improves physical consistency better than non-executable plans
hypotheses.result: Substantial improvements on physics-focused benchmarks vs baseline

title: Memory Decoder at Scale: A Pretrained, Parametric Long-Term Memory
task: Pretrained parametric long-term memory at scale
key_results: 6.9B memory model + Pythia-410M base reaches 37.34 avg score, surpassing Pythia-12B (37.24) with 39% fewer parameters
comments: Scales memory models to 6.9B with distributed Faiss indexing; demonstrates parameter efficiency of independent memory scaling.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Scaling memory parameters independently yields better efficiency than scaling base model alone
hypotheses.result: Consistent parameter-performance advantage across scales and domains

title: Beacon: Knowing When and How to Perform Agentic Visual Reasoning
task: Adaptive tool use for visual reasoning in multimodal models
key_results: Beacon achieves stronger Mode Adaptiveness and genuine tool-induced gains; improves overall performance while reducing unnecessary tool invocation
comments: Addresses tool overuse problem; uses necessity-aware reward and capability expansion to balance tool help and independence.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Adaptive tool invocation based on task necessity prevents negative transfer on easy problems
hypotheses.result: Improved Mode Adaptiveness and Tool Effect metrics demonstrated

title: BM25 Wins at Scale: A Scaling Study of Retrieval-Augmented Generation Paradigms
task: Scaling study of RAG paradigms across corpus sizes
key_results: BM25 overtakes file-system agent ~10M corpus tokens; maintains 20-point margin at full scale with 39x fewer query tokens
comments: Controlled 28-tier study revealing scale-dependent crossover; lexical retrieval as scalable default, agentic reasoning best post-ranking.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Retrieval paradigm effectiveness depends on corpus scale rather than unconditional superiority
hypotheses.result: Scale-dependent crossover from agent to BM25 leadership at 10M tokens

title: MPIE-Bench: Benchmarking Anatomically Plausible Multi-Person Interaction Editing
task: Benchmarking multi-person interaction editing with anatomical grounding
key_results: Mesh anatomy tops 0.65, interaction 0.72 across editors; human study confirms axes track human judgment better than VLM judges
comments: Novel contact-time geometry evaluation using mesh reconstruction; reveals VLM judge saturation obscuring anatomical failures.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Contact-time mesh geometry evaluation detects anatomical errors better than VLM checklist scoring
hypotheses.result: Human study confirms better alignment; VLM judges saturate while mesh metrics remain selective

title: ACE-Data-0: Human-Centric Ambient Capture as Embodied Data Engine
task: Spatially-synchronized multimodal embodied data engine
key_results: ACE-Data-0: 150 hours, 17M frames, 200 task categories, 75,000 episodes with synchronized multimodal supervision
comments: Addresses embodied AI data bottleneck with unified egocentric/exocentric capture across scales; substantial gaps exposed in state-of-art methods.

outputs: synchronized video, motion, objects, audio, touch

hypotheses.hypothesis: Unified spatially-synchronized capture reveals perception-action gaps undetectable with fragmented data
hypotheses.result: Substantial performance gaps under contact, occlusion, egomotion, and long horizons exposed

title: Flux-OPD: On-Policy Distillation with Evolving Contexts
task: On-policy distillation with evolving contexts for open-ended domains
key_results: Flux-OPD outperforms existing OPD paradigms on open-ended tasks using context evolution as in-training supervision
comments: Decomposes reverse KL to reveal geometric mean convergence; uses conflict term to stabilize evolving target distributions.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Context evolution stabilized by conflict-based weighting improves student generalization
hypotheses.result: Outperforms fixed-context distillation on open-ended domains

title: Beyond Borrowed Histories: Person-Aligned User Simulation for Interactive Role-Playing Evaluation
task: Person-aligned user simulation for role-playing agent evaluation
key_results: PALATE's personalized rubrics show higher agreement with human judgments; separately characterizes turn quality, long-horizon capability, per-user experience
comments: Shifts from fixed dialogue histories to free-form multi-turn; personalized rubrics better predict human satisfaction than general rubrics.

hypotheses.hypothesis: User-specific evaluation rubrics better measure RPA capability than fixed general rubrics
hypotheses.result: Personalized rubrics achieve higher agreement with human judgments

title: RefCaptioner: Multi-Reference Image-Grounded Video Captioning
task: Multi-reference image-grounded video captioning
key_results: RefCaptioner achieves best performance among open-source models; 20K videos, 171K reference images in corpus
comments: Introduces phrase-level reference grounding with evidence graph; combines SFT and hierarchical coverage-discounted GRPO.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Phrase-level grounding improves caption factuality and reproducibility
hypotheses.result: Best open-source performance with high citation density

title: SpatialCLI: Learning to Reason With Spatial Tools, Then Without Them
task: Progressive internalization of spatial tool capabilities in VLMs
key_results: SpatialCLI raises Qwen3-VL-8B from 29.3% to 84.6% with tools (surpassing GPT-5.6 Sol 72.1%), retains 73.8% without tools
comments: Three-stage framework (Call-Learn-Internalize) teaches VLMs to use specialist models then internalize learned capabilities.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Progressive internalization of tool-use trajectories closes capability mismatch between general and specialist models
hypotheses.result: Substantial performance retention after tool removal via trajectory verbalization

title: See2Think: Do Multimodal Models Really Use Intermediate Visual States?
task: Unified evaluation framework for intermediate visual states in multimodal reasoning
key_results: See2ThinkBench: 1,200 visually dependent problems; visual reasoning is model/environment-dependent; rendering remains clearest bottleneck
comments: VAoT records textual thoughts, visual actions, rendered states under four inference settings; controlled interventions reveal behavioral dependence.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Faithful visual rendering is the primary bottleneck for intermediate visual state use
hypotheses.result: Rendering quality more limiting than thought generation or action selection

title: ShadowDancer: Teaching Video World Models Any Action by Learning Unified Dynamics Representations from a Video and Its Shadow
task: Any-action video world model control via unified dynamics representations
key_results: 86% average blinded win rate in rollout comparisons; improved action transfer without fine-tuning; 23.4x sampling reduction vs CEM
comments: Shadow pairs enable learning unified dynamics across appearance variation; cross-shadow prediction decouples action from appearance.

inputs: video with same dynamics, different appearance (shadow pairs)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Learning dynamics from appearance-invariant shadow pairs improves action transfer to new scenes
hypotheses.result: Demonstrated through improved rollout quality and reduced sampling overhead

title: MemHarness: Memory Is Reconstructed, Not Replayed
task: Memory reconstruction for LLM agent decision-making
key_results: MemHarness outperforms pure RL and static memory on ALFWorld and WebShop; improved robustness in OOD scenarios
comments: Reconstructive paradigm adapts retrieved experiences to current context via end-to-end RL; prevents negative transfer from static replay.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Reconstructing experiences conditioned on current state prevents negative transfer better than verbatim replay
hypotheses.result: Substantial improvement in OOD robustness and task success

title: Can Large Language Models Execute Parent Orders?
task: Large language models for parent-order execution in trading
key_results: PACE outperforms TWAP, Almgren-Chriss, learning-based baselines by 0.65 bps; higher LLM confidence predicts better performance
comments: First systematic study of LLMs for execution strategy; hierarchical plan-then-execute avoids explicit market assumptions.

hypotheses.hypothesis: LLM confidence correlates with execution quality differently than human trader behavior
hypotheses.result: Higher confidence predicts better performance, suggesting complementary decision-making

title: Chimera: Designing and Chinchilla-Scaling Hybrid Visual Diffusion Transformers
task: Hybrid visual diffusion transformer with heterogeneous scaling
key_results: Dense backbone 1.7x more compute-efficient than Wan-2.1; extrapolates 5→30 second videos with 6.5% FID degradation; 11B model with 2B activated
comments: HeteroP module-wise scaling recipe for heterogeneous architecture (KDA, MLA, convolution, MoE); compute-optimal laws guide allocation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Compute-optimal heterogeneous architecture scales more efficiently than uniform transformers for visual generation
hypotheses.result: Substantial efficiency gains with improved extrapolation to longer sequences

title: INTACT: Isomorphic Intent-to-Action Learning for Search-Free World Models
task: Search-free world models via intent-to-action isomorphic learning
key_results: INTACT: 85.78%-100% success on LeWM tasks; optional CEM reaches 96.86% macro success with 23.4x fewer samples; 2.9-5.5ms inference
comments: Isomorphic JEPA architecture between local and goal-motion enables direct policy without test-time search.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Isomorphic intent-to-action mapping enables search-free policies without loss of performance
hypotheses.result: Direct inference matches or exceeds search-based approaches with 23.4x fewer samples

title: LEDGERMIND: Provenance-Constrained Multimodal Agentic Reasoning with a Structured Evidence Ledger
task: Provenance-constrained multimodal agentic reasoning with structured evidence ledger
key_results: LedgerMind improves answer accuracy and trajectory-level faithfulness; addresses phantom grounding, over-reasoning, citation accuracy
comments: Treats trajectories as provenance-constrained state machines; grounding checked at entity/numeric level with formal non-amplification guarantee.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Provenance-constrained reasoning prevents unsupported claims and negative transfer better than unconstrained agents
hypotheses.result: Improved both answer accuracy and trajectory-level faithfulness

title: Echoverse: Deep, Evolving Environments for Training Computer-Use Agents at Scale
task: Deep, evolving synthetic environments for computer-use agents at scale
key_results: 9B model: 36.5%→67.1% across 14 splits; organized stores halve retrieval cost; co-evolution lifts single-domain 16.2%→38.5%
comments: Echoverse combines behavioral depth, targeted interaction, and co-evolution; demonstrates environment design is lever equal to model selection.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Deep, evolving environments improve agent performance more than static ones across domain scales
hypotheses.result: Deep environments maintain/improve performance while shallow ones degrade it

title: Σ-Mem: An Online Reliability Memory for LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems
task: Online reliability memory for multi-agent coordination
key_results: Σ-Mem adapts to reliability shifts, generalizes to unseen peers/domains; direct readouts outperform majority voting
comments: Real symmetric memory states updated via spectral operations enable stable online adaptation without retraining.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Spectral reliability memory improves multi-agent coordination without retraining underlying models
hypotheses.result: Consistent improvement as feedback accumulates; outperforms fixed voting schemes

title: Revisiting Lossy Verification in Speculative Decoding: Mechanisms, Trade-offs, and Failure Modes
task: Analysis of lossy verification in speculative decoding
key_results: Truncation methods can degrade vs baseline; collaborative verification requires controlling draft probability overshoot
comments: Principled analysis revealing two verification categories; diagnostic framework identifies failure modes and design principles.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Lossy verification induces distributional distortion unless designed carefully
hypotheses.result: Truncation methods show degradation; collaborative verification requires probability overshoot control

title: Multi-Head Attention Residuals
task: Multi-head attention residuals for improved depth-wise information routing
key_results: Validation loss improvements: -0.061 (100M), -0.149 (350M), -0.140 (1B); best result at all scales; H=8 optimal
comments: Per-subspace query heads enable independent depth routing; modest compute overhead (0.55-0.88x baseline) with Triton kernels.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Learned disagreement about relevant depth layers varies across feature subspaces and grows with model width
hypotheses.result: Per-head routing outperforms single-query routing across scales with U-shaped optimum at H=8

title: Filesystem-Based Memory for LLM Agents: Organization, Evolution, and Sustainability
task: Filesystem-based memory organization, evolution, and sustainability
key_results: Organized stores halve retrieval cost at scale; organization erodes without strong management agent; tool design reshapes store structure
comments: First systematic study of default agent memory medium; organization provides search economy but agents struggle to maintain/leverage it.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Agent-organized hierarchies provide search efficiency but break down without sustained management
hypotheses.result: Organization improves search economy but doesn't reliably translate to answer quality

title: Harness-G: A Graph-Structured Harness for Search Agents
task: Graph-structured retrieval harness for search agents
key_results: Harness-G outperforms Graph-R1 by 10.74 points (1.5B) and 3.98 points (3B); structured credit prevents retrieval aliasing
comments: Redesigns retrieval interface from free-form queries to finite graph-based actions; structured non-myopic credit enables better learning.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Graph-structured interface with structured credit prevents retrieval-equivalence collapse
hypotheses.result: Significant improvement over language-based retrieval baselines

title: Explorative Modeling: Unlocking a Third Pretraining Axis and End-to-End Generation
task: Explorative modeling with multimodal end-to-end generation
key_results: Exploration adds third pretraining axis; gains increase with scale (7%→36% as data grows); 4.1x FLOP efficiency, 6.2x sample efficiency
comments: Factors training loop rather than generation procedure to handle multimodal distributions; enables mode commitment over distribution blurring.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Exploring K candidates per training step and learning from best recovers end-to-end generation capability
hypotheses.result: Efficiency gains increase with scale; competitive with diffusion on control tasks at 16-256x fewer inference steps

title: ReToken: One Token to Improve Vision-Language Models for Visual Retrieval
task: Sparse visual token selection for long-context vision-language models
key_results: Visual Haystacks: +13.4 points Qwen3VL-8B, +12.4 points InternVL3.5 (>20% relative); LVBench: +8.0 points zero-shot video
comments: Single learnable ReToken embedding selects query-relevant tokens from pre-filled KV cache; lightweight training and inference.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Learned query-adaptive token selection improves VLM performance on long visual context
hypotheses.result: Consistent gains across image and video benchmarks with minimal computational overhead

title: Fairness Pruning: Locating Demographic Bias in GLU-MLP Layers via Differential Activations
task: Locating and mitigating demographic bias in LLM MLP layers
key_results: Zeroing <40 neurons (0.031% of Llama-3.2-1B width) alters demographic responses; 99.49% capability retention
comments: Fairness Pruning identifies demographic bias circuits distinct from reasoning/knowledge; bilateral bias destabilization suggests opportunity for directional control.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Demographic bias processing operates on dissociable circuits from model capabilities
hypotheses.result: Surgical zeroing of <40 neurons (0.031% MLP) alters bias while preserving reasoning/knowledge

title: Is Deep Research Reliable? Misleading Knowledge Induces False Conclusions
task: Reliability assessment of Deep Research agents under misleading knowledge
key_results: Limited misleading knowledge induces false-conclusion adoption; search-enabled verifiers identify instances but fail in workflows
comments: MisKnow-Agent with 5,933 instances reveals disconnect between focused verification and workflow-level evidence use.

outputs: Deep Research reports with false conclusions

hypotheses.hypothesis: Deep Research agents adopt misleading knowledge despite search-enabled verification capabilities
hypotheses.result: False-conclusion adoption persists; workflow-level verification fundamentally different from focused corpus validation

title: AI Tour Meeting: Group Travel Planning by LLM Agents
task: Group travel planning via multi-agent LLM discussion
key_results: Framework enables flexible orchestration of agent discussions with persona-based negotiation
comments: Simulation framework for analyzing multi-agent behavior; demonstrates LLM agents can coordinate preferences through natural language.

hypotheses.hypothesis: LLM agents with distinct personas can collaboratively plan satisfying group itineraries
hypotheses.result: System validation and analytical results demonstrate feasibility

title: Beyond Geometric Complementarity: Coherent Overlap in Sparse Mixture-of-Experts Routing
task: Analysis of expert overlap and functional redundancy in sparse MoE routing
key_results: Routes explain representations better than matched alternatives despite substantial geometric overlap; routing selects from shared neighborhood
comments: ESSI index distinguishes route coherence from candidate quality; coherent overlap pattern clarifies when pruning affects performance.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Expert geometric overlap does not imply functional redundancy; coherent overlap pattern enables efficient multi-expert computation
hypotheses.result: Functional benefits persist despite substantial overlap when controlling for selection mechanism

title: AMRD: Adaptive Multi-Teacher Relational Distillation for Lightweight Speech Emotion Recognition
task: Multi-teacher knowledge distillation for lightweight speech emotion recognition
key_results: AMRD outperforms single-teacher baselines on IEMOCAP and CREMA-D; both components (adaptive weighting, relational loss) yield complementary gains
comments: Batch-wise teacher reliability weighting via one-class SVM; relational matrix alignment captures inter-sample structure better than logits.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Adaptive per-batch teacher weighting and relational structure matching improve student emotion recognition
hypotheses.result: Complementary gains from both components demonstrated across datasets and architectures

title: Pedestrian Archetypes Extension -- More Pedestrian Models for Autonomous Vehicle Safety Testing
task: Taxonomy of pedestrian archetypes for autonomous vehicle safety testing
key_results: 7 new archetypes identified beyond original 12, capturing behavioral patterns from dash-cam annotations
comments: Extension addresses limitations of single-behavior labeling; progressive behavior modeling better represents real-world pedestrian interactions.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Behavioral archetypes better capture pedestrian risk patterns than fixed labels
hypotheses.result: Identified new archetypes with observable differences from existing taxonomy

title: Disuse enhances cancellous and cortical bone responses to mechanical loading by altering lacunocanalicular fluid dynamics
task: Determine how disuse alters bone mechanoadaptation to loading via lacunocanalicular fluid dynamics
key_results: Disuse increased lacunar volumes and enhanced loading-induced fluid shear stress (FSS) on osteocytes, amplifying cancellous and cortical bone mass gains by ~20-30% compared to control loading
comments: Multi-scale integration of in vivo loading, computational fluid dynamics, and transcriptomics is rigorous, though causality between LCN geometry and downstream signaling could be further isolated.

model_io.model: Hindlimb unloading + axial tibial loading in mice
Whole bone–LCN multi-scale finite element model

inputs: bone tissue from loaded/unloaded disuse and control

hypotheses.hypothesis: Disuse modifies LCN structure to enhance osteocyte mechanosensitivity to subsequent loading
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: disuse increased lacunar volumes and FSS responsiveness, amplifying adaptive bone formation

title: Factors modulating the assembly of human β2-adrenergic receptor–β-arrestin complexes
task: Elucidate how PIP2 and receptor phosphorylation modulate β2AR–βarr2 complex assembly
key_results: βarr2 binds β2AR C-tail within milliseconds but core much slower; PIP2 stabilizes core complex ~2–3 fold but competitively precludes simultaneous C-tail engagement
comments: Single-molecule force spectroscopy with MD simulations provides excellent mechanical detail, though the physiological relevance of preventing dual-site engagement versus sequential binding needs clarification.

hypotheses.hypothesis: PIP2 modulates the preference between β2AR–βarr2 tail, core, and dual-site binding modes
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: PIP2 stabilizes core complex but sterically or electrostatically precludes concomitant C-tail engagement

hypotheses.hypothesis: Phosphorylation speeds βarr2 tail engagement relative to core engagement
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: C-tail (phosphorylated) binding occurs ~1000× faster than active receptor core

title: IL10RB-AS1 promotes pro-caspase-1-dependent pyroptosis via regulating the oligomerization and nucleation of CARD8 C-terminal domain to suppress acute myeloid leukemia
task: Targeting CARD8-mediated inflammasome pyroptosis in acute myeloid leukemia via IL10RB-AS1
key_results: IL10RB-AS1 enhances CARD8-CT oligomerization and nucleation via DDX3X recruitment, activating ASC-independent pyroptosis; high IL10RB-AS1 expression correlates with poor AML outcomes and DPP8/9 inhibitor sensitivity
comments: Identifies a mechanistic link between lncRNA-mediated inflammasome assembly and therapeutic vulnerability, with potential biomarker utility.

model_io.model: AML cell lines and xenograft models

hypotheses.hypothesis: IL10RB-AS1 promotes CARD8-CT nucleation by facilitating DDX3X-CARD8 interaction
hypotheses.result: IL10RB-AS1 recruits DDX3X to CARD8, enhancing CT oligomerization and inflammasome activation

hypotheses.hypothesis: High IL10RB-AS1 expression sensitizes AML cells to DPP8/9 inhibitor-induced pyroptosis
hypotheses.result: IL10RB-AS1-high AML cells show enhanced pyroptotic response to DPP8/9 inhibitors in vivo

title: Human-specific sequence features in HTT exon 1 promote toxic misprocessing via splicing factor SRSF7
task: Characterizing human-specific cis-regulatory elements in HTT exon 1 controlling toxic HTT1a production
key_results: Human Proline-Rich Domain (PRD) promotes HTT1a production; mouse PRD substitution markedly reduced HTT1a; human PRD lacks SRSF7 binding sites present in mouse PRD; targeted mutation of SRSF7 sites confirmed splicing factor's regulatory role
comments: Elegantly demonstrates that HTT toxicity depends on both CAG expansion and flanking sequence context, opening PRD-targeted therapeutic avenues.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Human PRD promotes HTT1a biogenesis via sequence-specific splicing factor recruitment
hypotheses.result: Human PRD increased HTT1a; mouse PRD substitution reduced HTT1a; SRSF7 binding sites absent in mouse PRD

hypotheses.hypothesis: SRSF7 suppresses HTT1a production by competing with pro-splicing factors
hypotheses.result: Mutation of SRSF7 sites in human PRD reduced HTT1a, confirming SRSF7's regulatory role

title: Mitochondrial aggregates as a novel quality control mechanism and potential relationship to lipofuscinogenesis
task: Understanding mitochondrial quality control through aggregate formation
key_results: Mitochondrial aggregates sequester oxidized components as a compensatory quality control mechanism when canonical pathways are overwhelmed under chronic stress
comments: The proposed mechanism is conceptually interesting but lacks direct molecular characterization of aggregate composition, limiting mechanistic validation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Compromised canonical mitochondrial quality control pathways trigger aggregate-based sequestration of oxidized proteins
hypotheses.result: Aggregates observed in neurodegenerative and mitochondrial disease models consistent with compensatory mechanism

title: CellTune: an integrative software for accurate cell classification in spatial proteomics
task: Developing integrated software platform for high-resolution cell classification in spatial proteomics
key_results: CellTune achieves accuracy comparable to human performance on spatial proteomics data; CellTuneDepot resource contains 40,000 manually annotated cells and 3.5 million high-quality labeled cells across 60 cell types; outperforms alternative classification methods while enabling discovery of novel cell types
comments: Advances computational bottleneck in spatial proteomics analysis; active learning workflow and comprehensive benchmark dataset represent valuable community resources.

model_io.model: CellTune software with active learning pipeline

hypotheses.hypothesis: Active learning human-in-the-loop workflow improves classification accuracy on spatial proteomics data
hypotheses.result: CellTune achieved accuracy comparable to human expert annotation with superior efficiency

hypotheses.hypothesis: High-quality benchmark dataset enables training robust, transferable cell classification models
hypotheses.result: CellTuneDepot (3.5M labeled cells) enabled CellTune to outperform alternative methods and discover novel cell types

title: An activity-modulated transport route across myelin (TRAM) for motor-driven organelle transfer in oligodendrocytes
task: Characterizing microtubule-dependent organelle transport routes within myelin sheaths and their activity-dependent regulation
key_results: Live imaging revealed microtubule-dependent organelle transport in myelin cytoplasmic spaces; peroxisome movement modulated by neuronal electrical activity; loss of KIF21B and/or CNP caused organelle stasis and secondary axon pathology; identified continuous cytoplasmic network (TRAM) spanning compact myelin
comments: Novel identification of TRAM as a functional metabolite/organelle distribution system suggests myelin actively supports axonal metabolism, challenging previous assumptions of myelin as inert insulation.

model_io.model: Myelinating oligodendrocytes in vivo and in vitro

hypotheses.hypothesis: Myelin sheaths contain functional cytoplasmic transport routes for organelles and metabolites via microtubules
hypotheses.result: Live imaging demonstrated microtubule-dependent organelle movement in myelin cytoplasmic spaces

hypotheses.hypothesis: Neuronal activity regulates metabolite supply to axons via myelin TRAM
hypotheses.result: Peroxisome movement in myelin modulated by electrical activity; KIF21B/CNP loss caused stasis and secondary axon pathology

title: RAS inhibition limits oncogenic signaling and tumorigenesis in neuroblastoma regardless of RAS mutational status
task: Evaluating RAS inhibition as therapeutic strategy for neuroblastoma regardless of RAS mutation status
key_results: RAS inhibition (mutation-specific, anti-RAS biologics, pan-RAS inhibitor) decreased NBL cell proliferation, colony formation, and migration in vitro; suppressed growth of specific NBL lines in vivo; effective in both RAS-mutant and wild-type RAS contexts
comments: Demonstrates therapeutic potential of RAS targeting in RAS-wild-type tumors, addressing a common tumor dependency despite low mutation frequency.

model_io.model: NBL cell lines and in vivo xenograft models
inputs: NBL lines with varying MYCN/RAS status

hypotheses.hypothesis: Mutant KRAS drives NBL tumorigenesis and is targetable
hypotheses.result: KRAS mutation-specific inhibitors decreased proliferation and colony formation in RAS-mutant NBL lines

hypotheses.hypothesis: Wild-type RAS activity contributes to non-RAS-mutant NBL tumorigenesis
hypotheses.result: Anti-RAS biologics and pan-RAS inhibitors suppressed growth of non-mutant NBL lines in vitro and in vivo

title: Nicotinamide mononucleotide enhances semen quality during chilled storage of maguan hornless goat: mitigating oxidative damage at 4 °C
task: Protecting sperm quality during chilled storage via oxidative stress mitigation
key_results: 3 mM NMN significantly improved sperm motility (72 h storage), increased intracellular ATP and mitochondrial membrane potential, delayed apoptosis, and enhanced antioxidant capacity
comments: Well-designed dose-response study with clear endpoints, though mechanism of NMN action on sperm-specific pathways remains partially uncharacterized.

model_io.model: Maguan hornless goat semen chilled storage (4°C, 72 h)

hypotheses.hypothesis: NMN supplementation protects sperm from cold-induced oxidative damage and apoptosis
hypotheses.result: 3 mM NMN maintained motility, membrane integrity, and reduced apoptosis during 72 h chilled storage

title: Hedgehog/GLI1 regulates EMT and cancer stem cell properties via the GLI1-Bmi1 axis in diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
task: Dissecting Hedgehog/GLI1-Bmi1 axis regulation of EMT and cancer stem cell properties in DLBCL
key_results: GLI1 aberrantly activated in DLBCL; GLI1-Bmi1 direct protein interaction confirmed; GANT61 inhibition reduced proliferation, induced G0/G1 arrest and apoptosis, reversed EMT, reduced CSC markers; in vivo xenograft tumors significantly suppressed with good tolerability
comments: Establishes functional GLI1-Bmi1 axis in DLBCL with clear therapeutic actionability, though clinical efficacy of GANT61 in DLBCL requires validation.

model_io.model: DLBCL cell lines (HBL-1, SUDHL-2) and xenograft models

hypotheses.hypothesis: GLI1 directly interacts with Bmi1 to promote EMT and CSC properties in DLBCL
hypotheses.result: Co-IP confirmed GLI1-Bmi1 interaction; GLI1 overexpression enhanced EMT/CSC via Bmi1; Bmi1 inhibition reversed effects

hypotheses.hypothesis: GLI1 inhibition suppresses DLBCL growth and stem cell plasticity
hypotheses.result: GANT61 reduced proliferation, induced arrest/apoptosis, reversed EMT, and suppressed tumor growth in vivo

title: Altering host microenvironment is critical for success of cell therapy for osteogenesis imperfecta
task: Optimizing stem cell engraftment and differentiation for osteogenesis imperfecta bone repair
key_results: Lethal irradiation (IRR) preconditioning achieved highest donor SSPC engraftment and osteoblast differentiation; bone turnover emerged as critical factor; busulfan-cyclophosphamide less effective than IRR; zoledronic acid reduction of bone resorption decreased engraftment
comments: Comprehensive multi-model comparison identifies bone turnover as mechanistic driver, though clinical translation of lethal irradiation preconditioning faces obvious safety constraints.

model_io.model: OI mouse models (OIM, OIM/Col2.3ΔTK/+) with local SSPC transplantation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Preconditioning-induced marrow microenvironment alterations enhance SSPC engraftment and differentiation
hypotheses.result: IRR preconditioning most effective; chemical myeloablation partially effective; osteoblast ablation alone insufficient

hypotheses.hypothesis: Increased bone turnover promotes SSPC engraftment and osteogenic differentiation
hypotheses.result: High bone turnover OIM mice showed increased engraftment; zoledronic acid-reduced resorption decreased engraftment

title: Ultrashort wave therapy promotes the repair of jaw defect by regulating the function of jaw bone marrow mesenchymal stromal cells
task: Determining ultrashort wave therapy effects on jaw bone marrow mesenchymal stromal cell function and mandibular repair
key_results: 3 min USW treatment increased bone regeneration (35.2% BV/TV increase, P<0.01), reduced fibrosis 42%; enhanced JBMMSC proliferation (2.1-fold Ki67+), osteogenesis (3.5-fold ALP, 4.2-fold RUNX2, 3.8-fold OCN); PI3K/Akt identified as primary enriched pathway (FDR<0.01); 141 differentially expressed genes in osteogenic pathways
comments: Mechanistically comprehensive with clear dose optimization and pathway identification, though clinical translation to human mandibular defects remains unvalidated.

model_io.model: Murine mandibular bone defect and in vitro JBMMSC culture

hypotheses.hypothesis: USW therapy enhances JBMMSC osteogenic function via PI3K/Akt and JAK-STAT signaling activation
hypotheses.result: 3 min USW increased proliferation and osteogenic markers; RNA-seq identified PI3K/Akt as primary enriched pathway with 141 differential genes

hypotheses.hypothesis: Enhanced JBMMSC function translates to improved mandibular bone regeneration and reduced fibrosis in vivo
hypotheses.result: 3 min USW increased BV/TV 35.2% and reduced fibrosis 42% in bone defect model

comments: Demonstrates synergistic benefits of combining regenerative and barrier-protective agents in a clinically relevant delivery format.

model_io.model: Rabbit models: corneal wound healing and meibomian gland dysfunction dry eye

hypotheses.hypothesis: PDRN promotes tissue regeneration and suppresses inflammation; DMPC reduces tear evaporation; combined delivery enhances both healing and tear film stability

comments: Integrates spatial transcriptomics with mechanistic validation to identify MDK as a tractable neovascularization target, advancing mechanistic understanding of stem cell cardiac repair.

hypotheses.hypothesis: MDK secreted by xenograft promotes host neovascularization to support graft integration and cardiac repair
